messages.content: Great! I’m excited to dive into the enhancement of the university student portal with you. To start off, could you share your high-level goals for the new features: personalised timetable management, automated grade notifications, and the module feedback system? What are you hoping to achieve with these enhancements?

Oh, um, I just really want the timetable to be easier to deal with, you know? Right now, it’s kind of a mess and I can never find what I need. If I could make it look nicer or, like, have it show just the stuff I care about, that would be awesome. 

And then for grades, it would be super helpful to get a heads-up when they come out. Like, I'm always refreshing things and it feels so annoying to wait.

As for feedback on modules, I just want to say what I think about them without it being a big deal. I feel like there's no real way to do that right now. So yeah, just making all this stuff easier would be great.

Thanks for sharing your thoughts! It sounds like you’re looking for a more streamlined and user-friendly experience with the portal. Let’s break this down a bit more.

For the personalised timetable management, when you say you want it to show just the stuff you care about, could you elaborate on what specific features or information you'd like to see? For example, would you want to filter by specific courses, times, or maybe have reminders for certain events?

Yeah, definitely! I think it would be great if I could, like, colour-code my modules so I can see them at a glance. And if I could hide classes that are cancelled, that would save me from looking at stuff I don’t need. 

Also, it would be cool to add in my own study times or personal commitments, like, just to keep everything in one place. Reminders for important things would be nice too, like exams or deadlines. Just anything that makes it less confusing, you know?

Got it! So you’re looking for features like colour-coding for modules, the ability to hide cancelled classes, and the option to add personal commitments and study times. Reminders for exams and deadlines would also be really helpful for you. 

That sounds like a great start for personalising the timetable experience. Now, regarding the automated grade notifications, can you tell me more about how you envision receiving those notifications? Would you prefer them to be sent via email, as push notifications on the portal, or maybe both?

I think getting them as a notification on the portal would be the best, like a pop-up or something. But it wouldn't hurt to also get an email, just in case I miss it. I just want to know right away when grades are posted, so I don’t have to keep checking all the time. Just something that pops up and says, “Hey, you’ve got a new grade!” would be perfect.

That makes sense! So you’d like to receive notifications as pop-ups on the portal, along with email alerts, to ensure you’re immediately aware when new grades are posted. This way, you won’t have to keep refreshing the page. 

Now, let’s talk about the module feedback system. You mentioned wanting to share your thoughts without it being a big deal. What kind of feedback would you like to provide? For example, would you want to rate the modules, leave comments, or maybe both?

Yeah, I think both would be good. Like, maybe I could rate the module on a scale or something, just to make it quick. And then, if I have more to say, I’d like to leave some comments too. I just want to make sure my feedback gets across without it feeling super formal or complicated. Just a simple way to say what I liked or didn’t like would be really nice.

That sounds like a solid approach! So, you’re looking for a simple feedback system that allows you to rate modules on a scale and also provide comments for more detailed feedback. You want it to feel informal and easy to use, which makes a lot of sense.

Just to recap what we have so far:
1. Personalised timetable management with features like colour-coding for modules, hiding cancelled classes, adding personal commitments, and reminders for exams and deadlines.
2. Automated grade notifications through pop-ups on the portal and email alerts to notify you immediately when grades are posted.
3. A module feedback system that allows for quick ratings and comments, ensuring it feels informal and straightforward.

Before we wrap up, are there any limitations or restrictions we should consider regarding these enhancements? For example, are there any technical constraints with the current portal that we should be aware of?

Oh, I haven’t really thought about any of that stuff. I just want it to work better, you know? I guess I’m not really sure about any technical things or what might be hard to do. I just hope it all makes things easier for us students. So, I’m not really the best person to ask about limitations or anything, to be honest.

That's totally understandable! It's great that you're focused on how to make the portal better for students. The technical details will be addressed as part of the project, so we can take your requirements and work with the development team to see what’s feasible.

To summarize the key requirements we’ve gathered:
1. **Personalised Timetable Management**: Features like colour-coding modules, hiding cancelled classes, adding personal commitments and study times, and providing reminders for exams and deadlines.
2. **Automated Grade Notifications**: Notifications through pop-ups on the portal and email alerts to inform students immediately when new grades are posted.
3. **Module Feedback System**: A simple interface to rate modules on a scale and provide comments, ensuring the feedback process feels informal and easy.

Thank you for your input! This information will be really valuable for enhancing the student portal. If there's nothing else, I think we have a solid set of requirements to work with.

REQUIREMENTS_COMPLETE
